Phil did a great job at the wheel and Will was an excellent tour guide pointing out many places of interest and telling us much of the history. Of course, the highlight was the dolphins playing and jumping in the boat’s wake. We had just enough time on the island to enjoy a delicious lunch and explore some and relax
